visual_identity.core_identity: A massive burrowing insect predator with a heavily armored segmented body, powerful mandibles, and digging legs.
visual_identity.silhouette: Long low insect body with broad armored thorax, tapered abdomen, six strong legs, and large front mandibles.
visual_identity.head_features: Armored insect head with oversized paired mandibles, small eyes, and short antennae.
visual_identity.body_shape: Three-part insect anatomy with six legs, plated thorax, segmented abdomen, and reinforced forelegs for digging.
visual_identity.surface: Large chitin plates with simple seams; avoid tiny shell texture.
visual_identity.limb_structure: Exactly six insect legs attach to the thorax; reinforced forelegs dig, rear legs brace, and no wings, spider legs, or scorpion tail are added.

accuracy_checks: six legs are visible or clearly implied
armor plates are broad and colorable

known_failure_modes.correction: remove dragon head; restore six legs, large mandibles, segmented armored abdomen

known_failure_modes.symptom: creature drifts toward spider eight legs
known_failure_modes.correction: remove spider eight legs; restore six legs, large mandibles, segmented armored abdomen
remove scorpion tail; restore six legs, large mandibles, segmented armored abdomen

scene_identity.size_impression: large creature whose scale should read through its canonical silhouette: Long low insect body with broad armored thorax, tapered abdomen, six strong legs, and large front mandibles.
scene_identity.natural_posture: Low, grounded burrowing stance or half-emerged posture with the lower body visibly supported by earth; never airborne.
